note: Missing-key count per locale. SHRINK-ONLY, like tools/lint-baseline.json. A locale may never carry MORE untranslated keys than it does here. Raising a number is a deliberate act that shows up in a diff and needs a reason in the commit message; it is not something a build should be able to do quietly.
